Hari Rabu, 20 Mei 2026 telah dilakukan penjajakan kerja sama di bidang Life Science dan healthcare Universitas Padjadjaran melalui Laboratorium Sentral. Kerja sama ini diharapkan dapat membuka peluang sinergi dalam pengembangan layanan pengujian dan analisis laboratorium, serta mendukung penguatan riset terapan, peningkatan kapasitas, dan pengembangan layanan berbasis kebutuhan industri.

posts.caption:
Join us for an interactive hands-on workshop focused on Confocal Laser Scanning Microscopy (CLSM) and its applications in biomedical and cell biology research. This workshop will provide participants with fundamental principles of confocal microscopy, sample preparation techniques, and direct observation sessions using the Olympus CLSM FV1200 system.

✨ Featuring invited speakers:
dr. Astrid Feinisa Khairani, M.Kes., Ph.D
Faculty of Medicine — Universitas Padjadjaran

Muhammad Yusuf, Ph.D
Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences — Universitas Padjadjaran

📅 June 10–11, 2026
📍 UNPAD Bioimaging Laboratory (UBL), Jatinangor

This program is organized through the collaboration of WPM, Institut Teknologi Bandung, and the Scientific Imaging Center (SIC) to strengthen bioimaging knowledge and microscopy accessibility for researchers and students in Indonesia.

🎟 Commitment Fee: IDR 100.000
✅ Includes:

* KIT preparation
* certificate
* workshop module
* snacks & meals for 2 days

📌 Limited seats available!
Register now through the QR code or registration link provided in the poster.
